name: eci
title: Economic complexity
source: The Growth Lab at Harvard University, Growth Projections and Complexity Rankings, Harvard Dataverse
note: The Economic Complexity Index scores each country on how many different goods it exports and how few other countries can make them. It counts goods exports only, not services such as tourism, education or software. Ranks use the HS92 product classification.
